title: Tree Removal quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Removal of one large Eucalyptus saligna (Sydney Blue Gum) approximately twenty-two metres tall with a trunk diameter of seventy-five centimetres at chest height, located three metres from the corner of a residential property at 12 Acacia Street, St Kilda, VIC. The tree requires sectional dismantling with rope and rigging techniques to avoid damage to the adjacent garage and fence. Includes chipping all branches on-site. Stump grinding for the removed Eucalyptus to a depth of three hundred millimetres below ground level. Also includes grinding of one existing smaller Jacaranda stump, fifty centimetres in diameter, next to the driveway. All green waste to be removed from site and disposed of responsibly. Access is good, no crane or traffic management required.
workingDetail: Tree felling and sectional dismantling, Stump grinding (below ground), Wood chipping on-site, Crane hire (if required)
